historicalCaption: Delhi and environs: positions of British forces up to 31 July 1857; published in the Illustrated London News, 24 October 1857.
accuracyNote: Both images share a WGS84 extent. The 1857 newspaper illustration is approximately registered using five community control points; historical distortions remain. This is a visual comparison, not a survey or an exact measurement of river movement. Modern labels are editorial approximate anchors; modern road, water, rail and building geometries derive from OpenStreetMap.
coverageNote: Old Delhi and the northern Ridge; this is not the full NCT of Delhi or Mughal imperial territory.
